The '''B'rknaa''' [[Language/Legends|language]] was the native language of the [[B'rknaa]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Indobok]]. It consisted of loud, raspy sounds and didn't have a word for "I", since the B'rknaa shared a [[Hive mind/Legends|communal mind]].

The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] learned the B'rknaa language when [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jace Forno]] briefly abandoned him on Indobok in [[6 BBY/Legends|5.5 BBY]].
